Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
Begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 Else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 End if;
 
 ---message('RS='||:system.record_status);pause;
 
 If :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 If trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;
 if trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date) and :term_date is not null
 then
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;
End;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 
 default_value('N','global.displayed');
 If error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 --message('disp='||disp_format_mask);pause;
 
 If :global.displayed='N' then 
 message ('0022: Enter in correct format:'||'MMDDYYYY');
 :global.displayed:='Y';
 end if; 
 
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_CONFIG
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 nDup NUMBER:=0;
Begin 
if :system.block_status in ('NEW','QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;

--
-- Check all fields are entered
--
if :valid_patho_reduction_config.volume_type_set is null then
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
elsif :valid_patho_reduction_config.eff_date is null then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
elsif :valid_patho_reduction_config.final_max_no_bags is null then
 go_item('valid_patho_reduction_config.final_max_no_bags');
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
else

-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
IF :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 if trunc(:valid_patho_reduction_config.eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 If :equip_type is not null and :suspension_type is not null and :volume_type_set is not null then 
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nDup from valid_patho_reduction_config where 
 equip_type=:equip_type and :suspension_type=:suspension_type and volume_type_set=:volume_type_set
 and term_date is null;
 
 If nDup > 0 then 
 show_error ('0424');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 null;
 End If; 
 End If;
END IF; 
 
 
if :valid_patho_reduction_config.term_date is not null then
 if trunc(:valid_patho_reduction_config.term_date) < trunc(:valid_patho_reduction_config.eff_date)
 then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;

 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit; 
 show_error ('8010');
 :system.message_level := 0; 
--
end if;

END;
